name: Hitozuma Yuugi
source:
Hiroki is an ordinary uni student having too much free time. One day, he enrolls in a website that is to meet many people. He receives some messages later.... One is from Nahomi who works at a lunch shop where Hiroki goes often and another one is from Kyoka, a wife of a director of a big company. They have different personalities. Which women will he choose...?

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
广树是一名有着太多空闲时间的普通大学生。某天，他注册了一个用来认识很多人的网站。后来他收到了几条消息……一条来自广树经常光顾的便当店工作的奈穗美，另一条来自一家大公司董事的妻子京香。她们性格各异。他会选择哪位女性呢……？

[引自Himeya Shop]
